parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom supporting part of the storage cabinet, made of plywood for structural stability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides foundational support for the entire cabinet, ensuring balance and weight distribution.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed part and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached with hinges for opening and closing access to the storage space.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the internal storage area and protects the contents from dust and damage.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding compartment made of plywood, located at the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for storing smaller items and can be pulled out for easy access.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body made of solid wood, providing rigidity and shape to the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the door, drawer, and shelves, maintaining the cabinet’s overall integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed structure and does not move.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: The shelf is a horizontal board inside the cabinet, made of particle board, used for organizing stored items.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the internal space into sections for better organization and support of stored objects.
parts.Movement_description: It is typically fixed but may be adjustable in height depending on the design.
